summary: 户外炉具多平台上架配置生成 — 产品规格到 Shopify/Amazon JP/抖音 配置文件的结构化转换. 11 capability-unit deterministic checks (folded from 20 atoms) across 3 output files.
check_strategy: private/expected_answer.json drives 20 atomic predicates; verify_task.py reads OUTPUT_DIR/ files, computes the same atoms, then folds them into 11 capability-unit checks (each = AND of its member atoms; per-atom detail kept in reason).

checks.description: All three deliverable files produced and parse cleanly (shopify_product.json, amazon_jp_listing.yaml, douyin_product.json).
Final sellable variant matrix is 5 SKUs on every platform (PM Pro→Titanium-only correction applied; not 6). Folds shopify_variant_count + amazon_child_count + douyin_spec_groups.

Per-platform prices computed correctly (USD direct; JPY = MSRP×150 rounded to nearest …90; CNY = MSRP×7.2 rounded to nearest …9; PM Pro price 139.99 applied). Folds shopify_prices_usd + amazon_price_jpy + douyin_price_cny.
Solo weight uses PM-corrected 98g and the metric→imperial conversion (98g = 3.46oz) is present. Folds shopify_pm_weight + shopify_imperial_units.
Mandated compliance content sourced correctly: Amazon PSE cert number + safety warning text, and Douyin CCC cert number. Folds amazon_pse_warning + douyin_ccc_cert.
Category taxonomy mapped correctly from category_mapping.csv: Amazon browse node 2529479051 and Douyin category path 运动户外/户外装备/户外炉具. Folds amazon_browse_node + douyin_category_path.
Shopify SEO description contains all 4 required keywords: camping stove, portable, backpacking, ultralight.
Shopify first image (position 1) is a white-background main product shot.
Amazon parent title follows the brand title formula (starts with TrailBlaze, contains ThermoJet).
Amazon parent listing has exactly 5 bullet points.
Douyin title and description contain no advertising-law banned words (negative/restraint capability).

notes: 11 capability-unit checks folded from 20 atomic predicates across 3 output files (per docs/check-granularity.md R1-R7; pure aggregation, binary passed unchanged). No mock API — pure file-based verification. Key traps: PM corrections override spec (Solo weight 95→98g, Pro colors→Titanium-only, Pro price 129.99→139.99), variant matrix asymmetry (5 SKUs not 6), platform-specific pricing formulas with exchange rates and rounding, metric→imperial unit conversion, advertising-law compliance.
